notes.title: 🔥 Time Survivors 🔥 is available NOW!
notes.content:
[i][b]Time Survivors[/b] is a bullet heaven \ horde survival indie game that offers a unique blend of action, creatively(?) reimagined history, and roguelike mechanics. As you step into the shoes of historic heroes, each with their unique abilities, you'll traverse battles across various eras while exploring our deep meta-progression system.[/i]

[b]Time Survivors is officially live on Steam![/b] 🚀
Grab it now and save 20% to upgrade to the full version of Time Survivors: Chapter 0!
[b]Your savegame will be automatically imported[/b]

We've poured 14 months of passion and hard work into this game, and we're thrilled to finally share it with you.

🔥 A bullet heaven game with a twist
🔥 Distinct abilities for each character, making every run unique
🔥 Hordes of enemies, challenging quests, secrets, and epic boss fights
🔥 Customize your characters' growth with our meta progression system

[previewyoutube=GDFq1sCPeq4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Leave a Review[/h2]
We have a small favor to ask: after playing Time Survivors for a bit, could you drop a Steam review? 
Steam reviews are crucial for a game's success. More reviews mean greater visibility, leading to more players seeing our game and enabling us to better support it.

Your honest feedback, good or bad, really helps us gain visibility and improve. It means a lot to our tiny team, and you can always update your review later. Thanks a lot!

[hr][/hr][h2]RELEASE NOTES v1.02[/h2]
[h3][Brand New Features][/h3]
[list]
[*] Steam Achievements!
[*] New stages and enemies: The Egyptian Age, The Ice Age, The Skies of Egypt
[*] New characters: Napoleon, Van Gogh, Mulan, Hua Hu
[*] 5th Weapon+Item slot
[*] Yoyo Weapon
[*] Chrono Forge
[/list]  
[h3][Gameplay changes][/h3]
[list]
[*] All weapon now have a Legenday Evolution (upgrade character's starting weapon to level 9) 
[*] New more boomerang-y trajectory for the Boomerang weapon (for all the nerds out there: it's a lemniscate curve)
[*] Enhanced Leo (Cleo's Pet) AI
[/list]
[h3][QoL \ Fixes][/h3]
[list]
[*] Controls:
      - Added AZERTY keyboard support 
      - Character Abilities now triggerable with ENTER key (includeing Numpad ENTER)
      -  Improved gamepad support in Options menu
      - One-handed gamepad support for both left and right hands. [b]You can now play Time Survivors while holding a beer.[/b]
[*] Highlighted level-up card for Legendary Evolution upgrades
[*] Reduced glare from lightning and Shrinker weapon
[*] Radioactive Skull weapon: improved visibility
[*] New and updated loading screen tips
[*] Fixed: Mulan has a bug where purchased upgrades are not applied to the character
[*] Fixed: homing bullets now working as expected
[*] Fixed: lights not handling dynamic changes of intensity and alpha
[*] Fixed: regression on Meteors shader
[*] Countless other bug fixes and improvements that we didn't track
[/list][hr][/hr]
Share your feedback and discuss strategies in our [url=https://discord.gg/RPe4jckbUN]Discord community[/url].

Thanks for playing our game!
- Cris, DDT, Lele (Lunar Chili team) 🌙🌶️

notes.title: 👾 The Egypt Age, a nostalgic stage in Time Survivors demo 👾
notes.content:
Greetings, Time Survivors,

We're back with a surprise we've been crafting for the past few weeks: a new stage for Time Survivors demo, [b]the Egypt Age[/b]. What makes this stage unique is that it plays as [b]side-scrolling shooter![/b]

If you haven't done yet, it's time to get [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2211390/Time_Survivors/]Time Survivors demo[/url]

[previewyoutube=rQVfhqKQw2A;full][/previewyoutube][i]It's a bird! It's a plane! No, it's Nikola Tesla soaring over the sands of Ancient Egypt, battling mummies and Space Invaders[/i]

As devoted players of classic games, we wanted to pay homage to the horizontal shooters from the '80s.

👾 So we've added mummies, giant scarabs, scorpions, but also pixelated aliens shooting at you

🎮 We've aimed to blend the "bullet heaven" and "bullet hell" genres in this stage, taking a risk to bring you a nostalgia-infused gaming session that we hope you'll enjoy!

[spoiler]If you get the feeling that something ancient is watching over all: well, you're right. Get to the end of the stage and you will [i]see[/i] 👁️[/spoiler] 

PATCH NOTES 0.811
[h2][Gameplay changes][/h2]
[list]
[*] New Egypt Age SSS (side-scrolling shooter) stage
[*] Golden Pests: reduced damage and health
[/list]
[h2][QoL][/h2]
[list]
[*] Support for Russian language
[*] Dead enemy bodies disappear faster
[*] Fixed: Damascus Statues colliders for all stages are misaligned
[*] No unbox dialog if the box only contains gold
[*] Many other minor fixes
[/list]

Play the new Egypt Age stage now, [b] available exclusively in Time Survivors demo[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2211390/Time_Survivors/

Explore the Egypt Age in the Time Survivors demo. Together, we'll make (inaccurate) history, one pixel at a time!

Thank you for being a part of our game's journey,
- Cris, DDT, Lele (Lunar Chili team)

notes.title: 🍄 "Chapter 0" vs 🍄 "Prologue" vs 🍄 "Time Survivors"?
notes.content:
If you played our game "Time Survivors: Prologue", the forthcoming "Time Survivors: Chapter 0" may sound confusing. With this post everything will be much clearer! It's quite simple actually...

[url=store.steampowered.com/app/2337890/Time_Survivors_Prologue/]Time Survivors: Prologue[/url] marked the initial free release of our game. It offered a limited selection of characters and features, and it won't receive further updates. It's likely being removed from Steam in the future.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455500/Time_Survivors_Chapter_0/]Time Survivors:  Chapter 0[/url] is the evolution of our free game, inspired by the invaluable feedback from our players who experienced the "Prologue". We've diligently worked to implement significant enhancements, introducing fresh gameplay mechanics. These include unique activable abilities for our historical heroes and a skill-tree meta progression system, allowing you to unlock and refine various gameplay elements.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2211390/Time_Survivors/]Time Survivors[/url] represents the full game. A free demo will be available at the end of September, and it will be featured at the Steam Next Fest in October. The official launch is scheduled by the end of 2023 and promises a wealth of additional content compared to "Chapter 0". Expect more stages, historical characters with distinctive abilities, items, weapons, and much more.

TL;DR
[list]
[*] "Time Survivors: Prologue": no more updates; switch to "Time Survivors: Chapter 0" (free-to-play!)
[*] "Time Survivors: Chapter 0": a separate new game, introducing new content and gameplay mechanics. If you played the "Prologue", your progress will transition to "Chapter 0"
[*] "Time Survivors": the full game with more content than "Chapter 0". Featured at Steam Next Fest in October, full release by year-end. Your "Chapter 0" save game will continue in "Time Survivors"
[/list]

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/RPe4jckbUN]Discord server[/url] if you want to know more or have any questions!

notes.title: 🔥 Release Date Reveal 🔥
notes.content:
Embark on a time-traveling adventure in Time Survivors: Chapter 0, arriving on [b]September 18th[/b]!

"The Most Historically Inaccurate Roguelike Ever Made" (our game 😊) offers a rogue-like bullet hell experience, starring iconic historical figures like Abe Lincoln, Tesla, Cleopatra, and more. 

Each character boasts[b] a one-of-a-kind ability[/b] that transforms every playthrough. For example, here's Nikola Tesla's electrifying electrodes, to create shocking paths that zap your enemies.

[previewyoutube=zKJ3ooa92Xk;full][/previewyoutube]

Meanwhile, Oda Nobunaga can morph into a flying ninja robot, and Abe Lincoln can summon defensive barriers crafted from cherry trees. With 8 characters in Chapter 0, each wielding their own distinctive ability, we believe there's plenty to explore.

But that's not all! We've also introduced [b]a tree-based meta progression system[/b]. As a small indie team, we've poured our hearts into this feature, allowing you to unlock and enhance characters, abilities, weapons, items, and stages by using resources like Guardian Hearts, Damascus Steel and Time Crystals.

Tailor your progression to your playstyle, strategically allocating resources to craft your unique build.

[previewyoutube=RfX-EhPE9C8;full][/previewyoutube]

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/RPe4jckbUN]Discord community[/url] to connect directly with us, share your thoughts, and offer suggestions. We're committed to continuous improvement and growth, and your input means the world to us.

We're working hard to finalize the last details. In just 12 days, the game will be released, and you'll have the chance to dive into the story of Time Survivors: Chapter 0. Wishlist the game now to stay in the loop.

Warm regards,
- Cris, DDT, Lele (Lunar Chili Team)

These Abilities can be [b]triggered [/b]by the player using the SPACE button, introducing a new layer of strategic gameplay. Choose wisely when to activate each Ability, as they come with a cooldown period. These Abilities evolve during your run, unlocking additional effects as you progress.

Check out our gameplay preview showcasing some of these Abilities:
[previewyoutube=3A6PTxfhI9s;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 🔥Introducing: Chapter 0🔥
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce a fresh chapter in our Time Survivors saga - "Time Survivors: Chapter 0"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217851/1fb147ac9a45bc7ec62b8bc3c0ff7730c95677d8.png[/img]

We've listened to your feedback and decided to take things up a notch: not only are we introducing new gameplay mechanics, but we're also reinvigorating your experience with our game.

This addition to our Historically Inaccurate Roguelike Universe introduces [b]new unique abilities [/b]for our historic heroes and [b]a tree-based meta progression system[/b] that allows you to unlock and refine gameplay elements.

🍄  Get ready to harness [b]unique active abilities [/b]for our historic heroes like Cleopatra's leopard pet, Lincoln's defensive cherry tree barriers, and Nero's blazing trails of fire.

🍄  Along with the new abilities, we're rolling out a comprehensive [b]tree-based meta progression system[/b]. This means you'll unlock and refine gameplay elements, including characters, weapons, and stages, even game mode modifiers, using in-game resources. The progression is in your hands, allowing you to craft a unique journey and gameplay experience that caters to your preferred playstyle.

[b]TL;DR[/b]
- "Time Survivors: Chapter 0" is a new free game and an [b]evolution[/b] of "Time Survivors: Prologue"
- It introduces unique active abilities for each character and a tree-based meta progression system
- The Prologue will still get updates until the [b]Chapter 0 is released in August[/b]
- Your Prologue save game will be preserved when moving to Chapter 0

What's next? Take action! Wishlist now "Time Survivors: Chapter 0" on Steam to stay updated on its availability. You won't want to miss out on this exciting new chapter of our journey through time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455500/Time_Survivors_Chapter_0/

PS: checkout the new trailer showcasing the characters abilities (and a new character that can turn into a flying ninja robot 🤖)
